title: Industrial EDM: synthesized mechanical hits, industrial kit, riddim / growl basses, hit grammars, forms, four feels
doc: Pack glyphcore/industrial (CC0-1.0, docs/CONVENTIONS.md section 12, sources docs/INDUSTRIAL_REFERENCES.md). Every sound is synthesized with native superdough voices (FM at inharmonic ratios, noise sources, filters, envelopes, room); no samples, no worklet drive in the racks (docs/RACK_STANDARD.md section 9). C minor, one cycle = one bar of 4/4 on 16 steps.

section.title: Industrial: mechanical hits, kit, riddim, forms, feels
section.explain: Pack glyphcore/industrial (docs/CONVENTIONS.md 12; sources and sound-design recipes in docs/INDUSTRIAL_REFERENCES.md). Mechanical hits are synthesized racks: breakerClang, metalImpact, anvil, pipeHit (FM at the free-bar ratios 1.41 / 2.76 / 3.9 with a decaying index plus noise), relayClick, ratchet, chainRattle, metalShatter, hydraulicHiss (band-passed noise bursts), servoWhine / servoDown (saw with pitch envelope and vibrato), doorSlam, stampPress, slamImpact (sine with a pitch knock plus noise), rustBed, factoryAmb (noise floors). Kit: stampKick, clangSnare, metalClap, openChain; basses indSub, indRiddim, metalGrowl, clankBass, pressBass; build hissRiser(len). Atoms ind.: drum patterns, hit grammars hits1 / hits2 / hits4 / hits7 / hitsGap (hits per bar by section), bass lines, a 64-bar form as gates (intro, build, drop1, brk, build2, drop2, drops, notDrops, builds, vacuum, pickup, phraseEnd) and masks. Four feels: feel-indriddim, feel-indhalftime, feel-mechtechno, feel-noiseind.

racksDoc: Chain-only hook defs of glyphcore/industrial: synthesized mechanical hits (FM at inharmonic ratios plus noise), industrial kit, native riddim / growl / clank basses, hiss riser; every rack starts with its hygiene rack (docs/RACK_STANDARD.md).

atomsIngredient.title: Industrial atoms
atomsIngredient.doc: glyphcore/industrial atoms (ind.): half-time, four-floor and noise kick patterns, chain / relay / ratchet patterns, hit grammars by density (hits1, hits2, hits4, hits7, hitsGap), riddim / growl / clank / sub / rumble lines, the 64-bar form as gates and masks. Import with atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:atoms-industrial").

breakerClang.doc: circuit-breaker clang: square with FM at the inharmonic ratio 1.41 (index 5 decaying in 120 ms) stacked with a white-noise burst, one envelope of 350 ms, 24 dB/oct low-pass 7 kHz, a short small room: the thunk-and-ring of a heavy contact closing

metalImpact.doc: metal impact: triangle on C3 with FM at 2.76 (the second partial ratio of a free bar), index 8 falling in 60 ms, pink-noise body, 500 ms ring

anvil.doc: anvil: sine on G4 with FM at 3.9 (bright inharmonic partials), index 3 with a slow 400 ms decay so the strike stays metallic while it rings for 1 s

pipeHit.doc: pipe: triangle on D4 with FM at 2.76, low index (a hollow tube), 600 ms

relayClick.doc: relay click: an 8 ms white-noise tick through a 3 kHz band-pass (Q 2): the dry snap of a contact

ratchet.doc: ratchet: 12 ms band-passed noise ticks (2.2 kHz, Q 4), played as 16th or 32nd runs; a pawl over a gear

chainRattle.doc: chain rattle: 30 ms noise links 3-11 kHz; dense patterns with human jitter make the chain (pair with groove-human)

metalShatter.doc: metal / glass shatter: 250 ms of high noise (3.5-12 kHz); scatter it with degradeBy and 32nds for the shards

hydraulicHiss.doc: hydraulic hiss: a 50 ms-in, 600 ms-out burst of noise 2.5-9 kHz; the press releasing pressure

servoWhine.doc: servo whine: a saw on C5 that slides up a fifth over 300 ms (pitch attack) with 6 Hz vibrato, resonant 5 kHz low-pass; a motor seeking its position

servoDown.doc: servo power-down: the saw falls two octaves over 800 ms (a downlifter made of a motor)

doorSlam.doc: door slam: sine thump at 60 Hz with a 12-semitone pitch knock plus brown-noise body under 2 kHz, 400 ms

stampPress.doc: stamp press: sine and square at 48 Hz with a two-octave knock in 40 ms: a dull heavy press hit with a hard edge, 300 ms

slamImpact.doc: drop impact: sine at 45 Hz with a three-octave knock over 80 ms, brown-noise rumble, 1.2 s; the industrial downbeat (dry: a room put side energy under 120 Hz, audit)

rustBed.doc: rust noise bed: brown and pink noise 250 Hz-6 kHz, slow in and out; a quiet floor under the hits

factoryAmb.doc: factory ambience: pink noise through an 'o' formant (a hall hum), 300 Hz-4 kHz, a big room

stampKick.doc: industrial kick: sine at 50 Hz with a 30-semitone knock in 30 ms (the press), 300 ms, high-pass 38 Hz

clangSnare.doc: clang snare: triangle on E3 with FM at 1.41 plus white noise, 200 ms; the backbeat with a metal edge

metalClap.doc: metal clap: noise band-passed at 1.5 kHz (Q 1.5), 120 ms; the techno clap of the kit

openChain.doc: open chain hat: 120 ms noise 4-11 kHz

indSub.doc: industrial sub: sine, 5 ms attack, low-pass 300 Hz, mono; the weight under every growl

indRiddim.doc: industrial riddim: square with FM at 1.5 (a metallic fifth), resonant 24 dB low-pass 1.1 kHz with a short envelope snap, high-pass 120 Hz (the sub plays below); short, repetitive, the gaps are part of it; no worklet drive

metalGrowl.doc: metal growl: saw with FM at 1.41 (index 2.5 decaying to 40 %), alternating o / e formants, high-pass 100 Hz

clankBass.doc: clank bass: square and triangle with FM at 2.76, index 6 falling in 60 ms: every note starts with a clang and settles into a bass, high-pass 90 Hz

pressBass.doc: press bass (mechanical techno): triangle and square, 600 Hz low-pass with a short envelope, 5 ms attack; rolling 16ths

hissRiser.doc: hiss riser: white noise fading in over len seconds while its high-pass climbs (hpenv 4 octaves): pressure building in a pipe; len = bars x 240 / bpm

halfKick.doc: half-time kick: 1 and the and of 3

noiseKick.doc: noise-industrial kick: irregular, 1, the a of 1, 3, the and of 3

chainVel.doc: chain accents: the and of each beat loudest

ratchetFill.doc: ratchet run into the next bar (32nds then triplet 32nds)

relays.doc: relay ticks in the drum gaps

hits1.doc: hit grammar, sparse (1 per bar): one clang on the a of 4, a pickup into the next bar (intros, breakdowns)

hits2.doc: hit grammar, sparse (2 per bar): the a of 1 and the a of 4, answering the kick

hits4.doc: hit grammar, mid (4 per bar): in the gaps of the half-time kick and snare (builds, verse-like drop halves)

hits7.body: x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x
hits7.doc: hit grammar, dense (7 per bar): 3+3+2 accents; fills and the last bar of a drop phrase

hitsGap.doc: hits only where the half-time kick and snare are silent (call and response with the drums)

riddimLine.doc: riddim: one note in a 3+3+4+2+4 spacing; repetition and gaps are the hook

riddimAlt.doc: riddim answer: the same pulse moving to Eb2 and G1 (second half of a call / response)

clankLine.doc: clank bass on a 3-against-4 spacing (dotted quarters)

subLine.doc: sub under the half-time kick, each note held to the next (no envelope sidebands under 20 Hz)

rumbleLine.body: ~ c2 c2 c2 ~ c2 c2 c2 ~ c2 c2 c2 ~ c2 c2 c2
rumbleLine.doc: press bass rolling in the 16ths the kick leaves free

servoLine.doc: servo whine on the 4 of the bar

bed.doc: one held texture note per bar

intro.doc: intro: bars 1-8 (form: intro 8, build 8, drop 1 16, break 8, build 2 8, drop 2 16 = 64 bars)

drop2.doc: drop 2: bars 49-64 (switch-up: new hit grammar, same kit)

vacuum.doc: the last half bar before each drop: everything but the riser stops

pickup.doc: the last beat before each drop: a clang or ratchet pickup

phraseEnd.doc: the last bar of every 8-bar phrase: fills (hits7, ratchetFill)

relayNotes.doc: relay ticks as notes (for the feel's top slot, which is a note lane; the click ignores the pitch)

bedNote.doc: one held texture note per bar (the feel's harmony slot is a note lane; noise ignores the pitch)

shards.doc: shatter shards as 8th notes for the top slot

syntax.title: Pick an industrial feel (one import line)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:feel-indriddim", { as: "feel" })   // or feel-indhalftime, feel-mechtechno, feel-noiseind
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:atoms-industrial")
hooks.bind("kick", atoms.feel.kickRack)
hooks.bind("snare", atoms.feel.snareRack)
hooks.bind("perc", atoms.feel.percRack)
hooks.bind("hats", atoms.feel.hatsRack)
hooks.bind("top", atoms.feel.topRack)
hooks.bind("bass", atoms.feel.bassRack)
hooks.bind("harmony", atoms.feel.harmonyRack)
hooks.bind("fx", atoms.feel.fxRack)
kick: s(atoms.feel.kick).velocity(atoms.feel.kickVel).use("kick", { mode: "swap" })
snare: s(atoms.feel.snare).velocity(atoms.feel.snareVel).use("snare", { mode: "swap" })
perc: s(atoms.feel.perc).velocity(atoms.feel.percVel).use("perc", { mode: "swap" })
hats: s(atoms.feel.hats).velocity(atoms.feel.hatsVel).use("hats", { mode: "swap" })
top: note(atoms.feel.top).velocity(atoms.feel.topVel).use("top", { mode: "swap" })
bass: note(atoms.feel.bass).velocity(atoms.feel.bassVel).use("bass", { mode: "swap" })
harmony: note(atoms.feel.harmony).velocity(atoms.feel.harmonyVel).use("harmony", { mode: "swap" })
fx: s(atoms.feel.fx).velocity(atoms.feel.fxVel).use("fx", { mode: "swap" })
sub: note(atoms.ind.subLine).hook("indSub")   // the sub has its own lane under the riddim

syntax.title: Industrial hits grammar: density by section
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:atoms-industrial")
kick: s(atoms.ind.halfKick).hook("stampKick")
snare: s(atoms.ind.halfSnare).hook("clangSnare")
// hits per bar by section: sparse 1 (intro, break), sparse 2, mid 4 (build), dense 7 (fills)
h1: s(atoms.ind.hits1).hook("breakerClang").mask("<1 0 0 0>")
h2: s(atoms.ind.hits2).hook("breakerClang").mask("<0 1 0 0>")
h4: s(atoms.ind.hits4).hook("breakerClang").mask("<0 0 1 0>")
h7: s(atoms.ind.hits7).hook("breakerClang").mask("<0 0 0 1>")

syntax.title: Industrial form as gates (build, vacuum, slam)
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:atoms-industrial")
kick: s(atoms.ind.halfKick).hook("stampKick").tags("drums")
snare: s(atoms.ind.halfSnare).hook("clangSnare").tags("drums")
chain: s(atoms.ind.chain16).velocity(atoms.ind.chainVel).hook("chainRattle").tags("drums")
bass: note(atoms.ind.riddimLine).hook("indRiddim").tags("low")
sub: note(atoms.ind.subLine).hook("indSub").tags("low")
rise: s("x/8").hook("hissRiser(13.7)").tags("rise")
tagged("low").mute(atoms.ind.notDrops)
tagged("drums").mute(atoms.ind.intro)
tagged("rise").mute("<9b, 17b..65b")
tagged("!rise").mute(atoms.ind.vacuum)

syntax.title: Industrial dovetails: clang pickup, ratchet into the drop
syntax.code:
setcpm(140/4)
atoms.import("pack:glyphcore/industrial:atoms-industrial")
kick: s(atoms.ind.halfKick).hook("stampKick").mask("<0 0 1>")
fill: s("<~ [~ ~ ~ [x x x x]] ~>").hook("ratchet")
pick: s("<~ [~ ~ ~ x] ~>").hook("breakerClang")
slam: s("<~ ~ x>").hook("slamImpact")
